name: scaffold-template-library
body: Scaffold template library: create a new, deck-ready library at a target path — write `library.yaml` (name derived from the directory base name and validated against the `[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*` identifier convention, `format: 1`), the empty layout entries `slides/`, `sections/` and `media/`, and a minimal `themes/default/theme.css` (system fonts and neutral colours only) so that a deck's defaulted `theme` resolves (theme-selection); write only into a target without an existing `library.yaml` or layout entry — a populated target is left untouched and the command exits non-zero, with no `--force` flag (init-library); local filesystem only (offline, no git). It also writes the library-root full guide `AGENTS_KALIDE.md` (when absent) plus the `AGENTS.md` pointer per agent-guide-reference; both are inert non-library root entries (library-guide-layout).
